description: Defines an immutable Java class ActorAskCacheLoader that implements asynchronous cache loading by querying actors via Akka patterns, supporting multiple resource types and pub/sub mechanisms.

classes.name: ActorAskCacheLoader
classes.description: An immutable class implementing asynchronous cache loading by querying actors via Akka, supporting multiple resource types and pub/sub mechanisms.

methods.name: forShard
methods.description: Creates an ActorAskCacheLoader supporting multiple resource types with a sharded entity region.

methods.name: forShard
methods.description: Creates an ActorAskCacheLoader supporting a single resource type with a specified entity region.

methods.name: forPubSub
methods.description: Creates an ActorAskCacheLoader supporting multiple resource types with PubSub mediator.

methods.name: forPubSub
methods.description: Creates an ActorAskCacheLoader supporting a single resource type with PubSub mediator.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Performs asynchronous cache loading by sending a command to an actor and transforming the response.

methods.name: getEntityRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the actor region for a given resource type.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command for loading cache entries based on resource type and entity ID.

methods.name: transformResponse
methods.description: Transforms actor response into cache entry using resource-specific transformer.
